# Trust and Safety India Festival (TASI)

> The Trust and Safety India Festival (TASI) is an annual national convening in New Delhi that brings together government, industry, academia, and civil society to discuss trust, safety, and AI governance. TASI 2026 took place on 14–15 October 2026 at the India International Centre, New Delhi. TASI returns in October 2027; dates have not been announced.

TASI is organised by the Centre for Social Research (CSR) in partnership with the Trust and Safety Festival. TASI 2026 brought together 500+ attendees and 110+ speakers for 55+ sessions on child safety, age assurance, scams and fraud, women's safety online, platform regulation, and AI governance. Registration and applications for TASI 2026 are closed.

## Overview
- [Home](https://trustandsafetyindia.org): main landing page for the festival.
- [TASI 2026 Recap](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/tasi-2026): highlights video, five key ideas, launches, recommendations, and session recaps from the 2026 edition.
- [TASI 2025](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/tasi-2025): recap of the first edition.
- [About](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/about): background, mission, and organisers.
- [Themes](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/themes): the thematic areas TASI covers.
- [Contact](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/contact): contact information and enquiry form.
- [Media](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/media): media resources and assets.
- [Press Kit](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/media/press-kit): downloadable press materials.
- [Press Releases](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/media/press-releases): official announcements.

## Programme
- [Programme Overview](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme): the TASI 2026 and TASI 2025 programmes.
- [Inaugural Address (2026)](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-13-opening-remarks-and-inaugural-address): opening remarks and the inaugural address by Minister of State Jitin Prasada.
- [Opening Panel: Forces Reshaping Trust & Safety in 2026](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-11-opening-panel-forces-reshaping-trust-and-safety-in-2026): Roblox, OpenAI, Google, TP and The Quantum Hub on incentives and regulation.
- [Age Assurance and Age-Appropriate Design (2026)](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-23-panel-age-assurance-and-age-appropriate-design-building-better-experiences-for-children): privacy-preserving age checks.
- [Rethinking Women's Safety (2026)](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-40-panel-beyond-online-harm-rethinking-women-s-safety-in-a-changing-digital-world): moving the burden of safety from women to systems.
- [Report Launch: Designing for Online Safety (2026)](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-66-report-launch-designing-for-online-safety-reimagining-india-s-digital-service-regulation): The Quantum Hub's proposal for a duty of care.
- [Closing Plenary (2026)](https://trustandsafetyindia.org/programme/session/tasi26-67-closing-plenary-trust-and-safety-at-a-crossroads-how-should-we-rethink-safety-responsibility-and-human-wellbeing-for-the-next-era-of-technology): trust and safety at a crossroads.
